description: Root cause: repository manifest/catalog/server registration is already correct; .mcp.json registers aistock-local-data with --profile=data, profiles.py resolves local_data/data, TOOL_MANIFEST exposes 47 real local_data tools, and RA default_mcp_tools loads all 47 (23 read_only, 24 confirmation/side-effect governed). The observed missing tools are from the active Codex client/session MCP injection: tool_search exposes no mcp__aistock_local_data namespace and C:/Users/lc999/.codex/config.toml lacks [mcp_servers.aistock-local-data] while config.json contains it. This is client config/session drift, not a missing RA manifest entry. No fake tools were added.
